name: Shobab
overview: The name Shobab appears in Scripture as belonging to two distinct individuals: a son of King David and a son of Caleb. Shobab, as one of David's sons born in Jerusalem, is listed alongside Nathan and Solomon, highlighting his place within the royal lineage (2 Samuel 5:14; 1 Chronicles 3:5; 1 Chronicles 14:4). Separately, Shobab is also named as one of the sons of Caleb, emphasizing a different family line within the tribe of Judah (1 Chronicles 2:18). These references collectively show Shobab's presence in biblical genealogies, underscoring the importance of family heritage in God's unfolding plan.
